subject: Trial activation roadmap & owners — quick rollcall + kickoff window
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@novusops.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Trial activation roadmap & owners — quick rollcall + kickoff window

Hi Alyssa — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same playbook heading into the pilot: 

Summary (from today's discovery)
- Primary use case: automated summarization + internal search for support tickets (avg. 120 tokens per interaction).
- Success criteria (your asks): 1) 90th percentile latency < 600ms for 1–2k qps during peak ramp; 2) F1 >= 0.75 on labelled 500-ticket eval set; 3) no PII leakage in outputs.

Proposed 4-week activation roadmap
- Week 0 (this week): contract & SOW sign, SSO onboarding, and dataset handoff (samples).
- Week 1: baseline evals + initial config (quantization + batching) + monitoring hooks.
- Week 2: full ingest & KV cache validation; integrate prefix caching on a small shard.
- Week 3: performance tuning, run 500-ticket blind eval and compare to baseline.
- Acceptance: review eval metrics and sign-off from Ravi / Eng by end of Week 4.

Owners & asks
- NovusOps: provide eval dataset (anonymized) and confirm Ravi as technical champion.
- Redwood: Monica -> SSO & onboarding docs; Marcus -> monitoring & test harness; Sean -> overall project lead and point for commercial items.

Attachments: redwood-trial-checklist.xlsx (checklist + owner matrix).

Can you confirm Ravi as the technical owner and confirm a kickoff window next Tuesday or Wednesday (Jun 8–9)? Also copying our CS and infra owners to bind owners to dates.

Thanks — Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial activation roadmap & owners — quick rollcall + kickoff window

Thanks Sean — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications / tweaks: 

1) Success criteria tweaks
- Latency: 95th percentile < 650ms (we prefer a slightly relaxed SLO for initial ramp).
- Quality: target F1 >= 0.72 for week-3 blind eval; final acceptance at week 4 with F1 >= 0.75.
- Privacy: need confirmation on log retention policy and whether token-level logs are stored by default.

2) Stakeholders
- Ravi Kumar (ravi.kumar@novusops.com) — technical champion (confirmed).
- Procurement will need a short SOW + commercial note; procurement timeline is ~2 weeks for standard SaaS SOW.

3) Compliance ask
- Please attach SOC 2 Type II summary or checklist and a short note on SSO (SAML) support.

We can do kickoff Wednesday June 9 at 10:00 PT. If you can send a quick calendar invite and SOW draft, I'll route to procurement.

Alyssa
Senior Product Ops, NovusOps

Subject: Internal: prep tracker for NovusOps POC (internal owners & dates)

Internal — do not forward externally without Sean's sign-off. Below are the immediate items I will own and those I'm assigning to Marcus / Lauren so we hit Wednesday's kickoff smoothly. 

Action items
- Monica: SSO guide & onboarding playbook (deliverable: SSO-instructions.md) — due Tue Jun 8 EOD.
- Marcus: Monitoring probes + sample dashboards (deliverable: monitoring-playbook.pdf) — due Tue Jun 8 EOD.
- Lauren: Provision trial infra tenant and enable logging retention to 30 days (deliverable: tenant-id & access list) — due Tue Jun 8 EOD.
- Sean: finalize SOW language on data handling & retention (I will draft the technical bullets for Sean to include).

Notes
- For log retention: propose 30 days by default, then configurable via Dedicated policies.
- We should prepare a short note about token-level logging being disabled by default for the trial unless the customer opts in for debug mode.

I'll update the tracker in the shared Drive and flag any blockers by EOD Tue.

-Monica
